documents.unit: Office of the General Counsel (Academic Misconduct Policy 4.1.7)
documents.title: Academic Misconduct Policy
documents.stance_why: The only AI text is one bullet under Cheating, 'unauthorized use of artificial intelligence'. This implies AI is acceptable only when authorized, but the policy never says who authorizes it or what is allowed, so AI is banned unless authorized, which fits restrict.
documents.summary: A general university academic misconduct policy whose single AI provision lists unauthorized use of AI as a form of cheating. It gives no guidance on permitted uses, disclosure, or who grants authorization; the rest covers misconduct procedures and appeals.

units.why: The bullet 'unauthorized use of artificial intelligence' is listed as prohibited conduct under Cheating, so it forbids students from using AI without authorization and classifies it as misconduct. Misconduct classification (P36) fits better than a stance type because the passage only places AI in the misconduct list and sets no default rule.
units.policy: Unauthorized use of artificial intelligence is academic misconduct (cheating) and subjects the student to disciplinary action.

notes: Collect file has one included document with a single AI mention. The syllabus-statement sentence (courses should point to the misconduct policy) is not AI-specific, so it was not coded.
